outcome: glycaemic control (Fasting Blood Sugar levels, postprandial blood glucose levels)
onset of Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP)
occurrence of Large for Gestational Age (LGA)
neonates requiring Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) admissions
cohort: The study included 369 pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus who failed to respond to lifestyle modifications and required pharmacological management.
finding: The metformin group exhibited better glycaemic control (FBS and postprandial levels) and had a lower incidence of LGA babies and less need for phototherapy compared to the insulin group.
